title: GitLane Configuration
description: Repository-level configuration for GitLane across VS Code and IntelliJ IDEA.

developBranch.description: Staging branch name where task branches fork from and merge back into.

masterBranch.description: Production branch name that receives releases from develop.

remote.description: Git remote name used for fetch, pull, and push.

dateFormat.description: Local date prefix format used in task branch names.

separator.description: Separator between date prefix and sanitized task name.

returnToDevelopAfterRelease.description: Whether to switch back to develop automatically after releasing to master.

useNoFastForwardMerge.description: Whether merges use --no-ff to preserve merge commit history.
